_about: Read by scripts/triage-image-findings.py to decide how exposed each scanned image is.
Exposed is DERIVED, not listed: every reverse_proxy upstream in route_sources and every port published on all host interfaces.
content_consumers and internal are the services the proxy configuration cannot tell apart; each needs a reason.
A scanned service in none of these is treated as exposed and named in the scan summary.
A tracked file that mentions reverse_proxy must be in route_sources or not_route_sources, or the scan stops.
Runbook: docs/runbooks/trivy-policy.md, section 'The code-scanning tab for third-party images'.

route_sources.klai-portal/backend/app/services/provisi: writes one site block per tenant chat at provisioning time
route_sources.klai-docs/lib/caddy.ts: writes one site block per docs organisation and custom domain

not_route_sources.scripts/audit-compose-orphans.sh: reads the Caddyfile to find upstreams without a compose service; writes no route
not_route_sources.deploy/scripts/docker-orphan-audit.sh: the same audit on the host; writes no route
not_route_sources.deploy/grafana/provisioning/alerting/orp: alert text about that audit; writes no route

{names.librechat_container}.reason: per-tenant chat route that portal-api writes at provisioning, served from the image in LIBRECHAT_IMAGE

content_consumers.crawl4ai: renders arbitrary web pages in a headless browser for knowledge-base crawls
content_consumers.firecrawl-api: scraper API that fetches and parses arbitrary URLs
content_consumers.docling-serve: converts uploaded and crawled documents (PDF, Office, HTML) from outside
content_consumers.searxng: fetches and parses result pages from public search engines
content_consumers.glitchtip-worker: processes the error events that browsers submit through glitchtip-web
content_consumers.crm-worker: runs the CRM's background jobs, including mail and calendar sync that parse external messages

internal.alloy: collects logs and metrics on the monitoring network; no route from the proxy
internal.cadvisor: exports container metrics on the monitoring network only
internal.victoriametrics: metrics store on the monitoring network only
internal.victorialogs-content: second log store for message content; not behind the proxy
internal.postgres: database on net-postgres; no route from the proxy
internal.firecrawl-postgres: scraper job database; reached by firecrawl-api only
internal.redis: cache on net-redis; no route from the proxy
internal.meilisearch: chat search index on net-meilisearch only
internal.qdrant: vector store reached by the retrieval and ingest services
internal.falkordb: graph store; its port is bound to 127.0.0.1
internal.garage: object storage for recordings and images; not behind the proxy
internal.gitea: stores docs repositories for docs-app; not behind the proxy
internal.firecrawl-rabbitmq: scraper job queue; reached by firecrawl-api only
internal.glitchtip-migrate: runs database migrations once and exits
internal.ollama: runs local models for litellm on the inference network
internal.presidio-analyzer: detects personal data in text that portal services send; inference network only
internal.presidio-anonymizer: masks personal data in text that portal services send; inference network only
internal.docker-socket-proxy: filtered Docker API for the authz plugin on socket-proxy only
internal.docker-socket-proxy-ro: read-only Docker API for alloy on socket-proxy-ro only
internal.runtime-api-socket-proxy: socat bridge to the Docker socket for the meeting runtime
internal.vexa12-transcription-proxy: socat bridge from the bot network to the transcription service
internal.vexa12-admin-api: meeting-bot admin API on vexa12-internal only
internal.vexa12-meeting-api: meeting-bot API that portal-api calls over vexa12-portal
internal.vexa12-runtime: starts meeting-bot containers through the Docker socket bridge
